data.titulo: Ekicweka 2—Okusandaara kw’Amaizi Kuhika ha Kucungurwa Kuruga omu Misiri
data.contenido:
Abantu munana bonka nibo bakiziire okusandaara kw’amaizi, baitu hanyuma y’obwire bakeyongera kuba baingi. Hanyuma y’emyaka 352 kuruga ha Kusandaara kw’Amaizi, Iburahimu nubwo yazairwe. Nitwija kwegaho bingi nkoku Ruhanga yahikiriize omurago gwe ogw’okuha Iburahimu omwana w’obwojo ayayesirwe Isaka. Hanyuma mubatabani ba Isaka babiri, Ruhanga akakomamu Yakobo.

Yakobo akaba aine eka ey’aboojo 12 n’abaisiki. Batabani ba Yakobo 10 bakanobera kimu mugenzi wabu omuto Yusufu. Bahika n’okumutunda omubwiru mu Misiri. Hanyuma, Yusufu akafooka mulemi w’amaani muno mu Misiri. Kyonka enjara obu yagwire, Yusufu akalengesa bagenzi be okurora ngu obu baraba bahindwireho ha mitima yabu. Hampero amaka goona aga Yakobo, Abaisareri boona bakafurukira Misiri. Kinu kikabaho hanyuma emyaka 290 y’okuzarwa kwa Iburahimu.

Emyaka 215 Abaisareri bakagimara omu Misiri. Hanyuma y’okufa kwa Yusufu, bakaforwa abairu rubale. Mubwire obwo nuho Musa yazaliirwe. Ruhanga akamukozesa okucungura Abaisareri kuruga omu Misiri. Kutwarra hamu, Ekicweeka kya KABIRI nikitwara emyaka 857 ey’ebyafaayo.

NOMANYA ekintu ky’okubanza Nuha ekiyakozire obu yarugire omu ryato n’amaka ge? Akahayo ekihongwa rundi ekisembo hali Ruhanga. Nosobora n’okukirora omu kisisani hansi. Nuha akahayo ekisembo ky’ebisoro okusiima Ruhanga okukizaho amaka ge kuruga omu kusandaara kw’amaizi.

Notekereza ekisembo kinu Yahwe akakisiima? Ego. Akanihiza Nuha ngu taligarukira kuhwerekereza ensi n’okusandaara kw’amaizi.



Ensi yoona obu yayomere, Nuha hamu n’amaka ge bakatandika obwomezi obuhyaka aheru y’eryato. Ruhanga akabaha omugisa kandi yabagambira ati: ‘Muzalege, mukanyege, mwijuze ensi.’

Baitu abantu obu bakuhulirege ha kusandaara kw’amaizi, bakutiinire muno ngu kinu nikisobora kugaruka kubaho. Nahabwekyo Ruhanga akataho ekintu ekyakwijukizege abantu ngu taligaruka kwijuza ensi yoona n’amaizi obundi. Nomanya ekiyataireho okubaijukiza? Kyali omuhangaizima.

Omuhangaizima gurorwa haiguru obu omusana gujwa hanyuma y’enjura kugwa. Omuhangaizima gwine erangi nyingi enungi. Oragurozire? Ogw’omukisisani ogurozire?

Kinu nikyo Ruhanga yagambire: ‘Nindaganiza ngu abantu n’ebisoro tibirigarukira kuhwerekerezebwa n’amaizi omurundi ogundi. Ntaireho omuhangaizima omubicu. Kandi omuhangaizima obu gurabahoga, ndaijuka omurago gwange.’

Obu orora omuhangaizima, gukwijukya ki? Ego, okunihiza kwa Ruhanga ngu taligarukira kuhwerekereza ensi obundi n’okusandaara kw’amaizi.Okubanza 8:18-22; 9:9-17. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

EMYAKA nyingi ekahinguraho. Abatabani ba Nuha bakazaara abaana baingi, n’abaana nabo bazaara. Nahabwekyo ensi yabamu abantu baingi.

Omu h’abaijukuru ba Nuha akaba namanywa nka Nimurodi. Akaba ali musaija mubi muno. Akaba nahiiga enyamaiswa n’okwita abantu. Nimurodi akefoora mukama w’abantu. Ruhanga atagonze Nimurodi. Mubwire obu abantu boona baali nibabaza orulimi rumu. Nimurodi akagonza abantu abalindire mukikaro kimu nukwo asobole kubalema. Nomanya eki yakozire? Akagambira abantu kwombeka orubuga n’omunaara hagati. Barole hati mukisisani nibakora amatofali.

Yahwe Ruhanga tarasimiire ekyombeko kinu. Ruhanga akaba agambiire abantu ngu bagende baikale omu nsi yoona. Baitu abantu bo bakagamba bati: ‘Mwije twombeke orubuga n’omunaara ogulihika omu iguru, nukwo tuliranganwa muno!’ Abantu baali nibagonza kwetungira ekitiinisa, mukikaro ky’okukiha Ruhanga.

Ruhanga akeemereza abantu kwombeka omunaara. Nomanya nkoku yabemereize? Mubwangu akaburanganiza orulimi rwabu batandika kubaza orulimi orundi mukikaro kya rumu. Nahabwekyo, abombeki baali batarukusobora kwetegerezangana. Nikyo ekyo orubuga runu rwayetiirwe Baberi rundi Baburoni ekirukumanyisa “Kuburangana.”

Abantu bakatandika okufuruka okuruga omu Baberi. Ebitebe by’abantu ababazaaga haihi orulimi rumu bakagenda kwikara hamu mubicweka by’ensi ebindi.Okubanza 10:1, 8-10; 11:1-9. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

EKIIKARO kimu eki abantu baagenzire kwikaramu hanyuma y’okusandaara kw’amaizi kikaba nikimanywa nka Uru. Kikaija kumanywa nk’orubuga orw’amaani orwali rurumu amaju amarungi. Kyonka abantu baali nibaramya baruhanga ab’ebisuba. Kinu nikyo kimu eki baali nibakora omu Baberi. Abantu ab’omu Uru na Baberi baali batarukusisana Nuha na mutabani we Semu, abaali bagumizemu nibaheereza Yahwe.

Hanyuma y’emyaka 350 y’okusandaara kw’amaizi kubaho, omusaija omwesigwa Nuha akafa. Hakahinguraho emyaka ebiri yonka omusaija ow’orukurora omukisisani kinu nubwo yazairwe. Akaba muntu w’omugaso muno mumaiso ga Ruhanga. Ibara lye nuwe Iburahimu. Akaba naikara mu rubuga rwa Uru hamu n’amaka ge.

Kiro kimu, Yahwe akagambira Iburahimu: ‘Ruga mu Uru oleke ab’enganda zawe otahe mu nsi eyi ndakwoleka.’ Iburahimu akahuliriza Ruhanga yaleeka oburungi bwona obwali mu Uru? Ego, akakikora. Habwokuba Iburahimu akaba nahurra Ruhanga, nikyo ekyo yaizire kumanywa nk’omunywani wa Ruhanga.

Abamu ha b’enganda za Iburahimu bakagenda nawe obu yarugire omu Uru. Ise, Teera akagenda nawe hamu n’omwihwa we Loti. Tutweberwe ngu na Sara mukazi wa Iburahimu nawe akagenda. Hanyuma bakahika mukiikaro ekirukwetwa Harani, Teera ha yaferire. Bakaba bali hara muno na Uru.

Hanyuma yakacu, Iburahimu n’abomu nju ye bakaruga Harani bahika omu nsi erikwetwa Kanani. Hanu Yahwe akamugamba: ‘Ensi enu niyo ndiha abaijukuru bawe.’ Iburahimu akaikara omu Kanani naraara omu hema.

Ruhanga akatandika kukonyera Iburahimu muno, nukwo yatunga ebisibo by’entaama hamu n’eby’ebisoro ebindi, hamu n’abairu baingi muno. Kyonka Iburahimu na Sara bakaba bataine mwana wabo habwabo.

Iburahimu obu yahikize emyaka 99, Yahwe akamugambira ati: ‘Dora ekiragano kyange kiri naiwe kandi oliba ise w’amahanga maingi.’ Kinu kyakusobokere kita obu Iburahimu na Sara bakaba bakuzire muno batarukusobora n’okuzara omwana?Okubanza 11:27-32; 12:1-7; 17:1-8, 15-17; 18:9-19. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

NORORA Iburahimu ekyarukukora hanu? Aine omuhyo nikizooka nagenda kwita mutabani we. Habwaki nasobora kukora ekintu nk’eki? Okubanza, katurole nkoku Iburahimu na Sara batungiremu omwana.

Ijuka, Ruhanga akabaraganiza ngu nibaija kutunga omwana. Kikazooka nk’ekigumire muno, habw’okuba Iburahimu na Sara bakaba bakuzire muno. Kyonka Iburahimu akaba naikiriza ngu Ruhanga nasobora kukora ebi ebyaali nibizooka okuba ebitarukusoboka. Kiki ekyabaireho?

Hakahinguraho omwaka gumu kuruga Ruhanga araganiza. Hanyuma ya Iburahimu kuhikya emyaka 100 na Sara emyaka 90 ey’obukuru, bakazaara omwana ow’obwojo ou barukire Isaka. Ruhanga akaba ahikiriize omurago gwe!

Hanyuma ya Isaka kukura, Yahwe akalengesa okwikiriza kwa Iburahimu. Akamweeta: “Iburahimu!” Na Iburahimu yagarukamu ati: “Dora nyowe.” Hanyuma Ruhanga akamugamba ati: ‘Twara hati Isaka, omwana waawe wenka ow’ogonza, genda ha rusozi oru ndakwoleka. Obu orahikayo omwite omuheyo nk’ekihongwa.’

Ebigambo binu kabikatuntuza muno Iburahimu, habwokuba akaba nagonza muno omwana we. Kandi ijuka Ruhanga akaba araganize Iburahimu ngu abajukuru be nubo bakwikaire omu nsi ya Kanani. Kandi hati kyakusobokere kita kakuba Isaka aba afiire? Nobu Iburahimu araaba atarakyetegereze kurungi, baitu akorobera Ruhanga.

Obu yahikiire ha rusozi, Iburahimu akasiba Isaka yamuta ha kyoto ekyakaba akozire. Yaihayo omuhyo, kwita omwana we. Baitu mu kaanya ako, Maraika wa Ruhanga akamweta ati: ‘Iburahimu, Iburahimu!’ Na Iburahimu yagarukamu at: ‘Dora nyowe!’

Ruhanga akagamba ati: ‘Otateeka omukono gwawe ha mwojo kandi otamukora kubi. Hati manyire notiina Ruhanga habwokuba tonyimire omwana wawe omu wenka.’

Oku kakukaba kwikiriza kw’amaani Iburahimu okwakaba aine omuli Ruhanga! Akaba naikiriza ngu busaho ekirukulema Yahwe. Kandi akaba namanya ngu Yahwe yakuhumbwire Isaka kuruga mubafu. Baitu kitabe kigendererwa kya Ruhanga Iburahimu kwita Isaka. Mananu Ruhanga akaleetera empaya y’entaama kukwatira omu kisaka. Nukwo Ruhanga yagambire Iburahimu ngu agihonge mukiikaro ky’omutabani we.Okubanza 21:1-7; 22:1-18. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

LOTI n’amaka ge baikaraga na Iburahimu omu nsi ya Kanani. Kiro kimu, Iburahimu akagambira Loti ati: ‘Obunyansi tiburukumara amagana gaitu. Nkwesengerize twahukane. Iwe obworagya habumoso, nyowe ndagya ha bulyo.’

Loti obu yarozire ensi, yarora ekicweka ekimu okuba kirungi muno, kiine amaizi, n’obunyansi oburungi ha bw’ebisoro bye. Kinu kikaba Kicweka kya Yorudani. Nuho, Loti n’amaka ge hamu n’ebisoro bye bafurukiire. Hanyuma ya byoona batandikira kimu kwikara omu rubuga rwa Sodomu.

Abantu abomu Sodomu baali babi muno. Kinu kikatuntuza muno Loti habwokuba uwe akaba ali musaija murungi. Na Ruhanga kitamusemeze. Hampero, Ruhanga akatuma bamaraika kugambira Loti ngu akaba nagenda kuhwerekereza Sodomu hamu n’orubuga orukaba ruruheriire orwa Gomora habw’obubi bwazo.

Abamaraika bakagambira Loti bati: ‘Rahuka! Twaara mukazi waawe n’abahara bawe babiri oruge hanu!’ Baitu Loti nab’omuka ye bakaba nibekerereza, nukwo bamaraika kubakwata ha mikono n’okubaturukya omu rubuga. Baitu maraika omu akabagambira ngu: ‘Mwiruke okukiza obwomezi bwanyu! Kyonka mutarora enyuma. Mwirukire omu nsozi nukwo muleke okufa.’ Loti n’abahara be bakahurra ekiragiro kinu bakairuka kuruga omu Sodomu batemeriire nakake kandi batarole enyuma. Baitu omukazi wa Loti atahurre. Obu bakaba bagenzireho ekicweka kuruga omu Sodomu, muka Loti akemerra yarora enyuma. Mu kaanya ako akafooka empagi y’ekisura. N’osobora kumurora omu kisisani?

Mu kinu nitusobora kwegamu eisomo erirungi. Nikyoleka ngu Ruhanga ajuna abo boona abamworobera, kyonka abo abatamuhurra balifeerwa obwomezi bwabu.Okubanza 13:5-13; 18:20-33; 19:1-29; Luka 17:28-32; 2 Petero 2:6-8. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

NOMANYA omukazi onu anyakuli omu kisisani? Ibara lye nuwe Rebeka. Kandi omusaija owarukwija kutangatangana nuwe Isaka. Nagenda kuba mukazi we. Kinu kikabaho kita?

Ise Isaka, Iburahimu, akagonza atungire mutabani we omukazi omurungi. Atagonze Isaka kuswera abakazi ab’omu nsi ya Kanani, habwokuba abantu banu baali nibaramya baruhanga ab’ebisuba. Iburahimu akeeta omwiru we yamutererra ngu: ‘Ningonza ogarukeyo Harani mubene baitu, otungire mutabani wange Isaaka omukazi.’

Omwiru wa Iburahimu akatwara engamira ikumi yatandikiraho orugendo. Obu yahikire haihi abanyabuzaale ba Iburahimu nambere baali nibaikara yayemerra ha iziba. Bwali bwire bw’orwebagyo, obwire abakazi ab’omurubuga obu batahiramu amaizi. Omwiru wa Iburahimu yasaba Yahwe: ‘Nkanihire omukazi arantahira amaizi hamu n’engamira zange araba ogu owokomere kuba mukazi wa Isaka.’

Mubwire obu, Rebeka akaija kutaha amaizi. Omwiru nukwo kumusaba amaizi g’okunywa, nukwo kugamuha. Aho Rebeka akagenda omu maiso n’okutahira engamira zoona amaizi ezikaba ziine iroho. Gunu gukaba guli mulimu gw’amaani habwokuba engamira enywa amaizi maingi muno.

Rebeka abu yamazire kukora ebi byoona, omwiru wa Iburahimu nukwo kumukaguza ibara lyaise. Kandi akamusaba arale owabu. Akamugambira ati: “Ibara lyaise nyowe nuwe Besueri, kandi haroho ekissika nambere hosobora kurara.” Omwiru wa Iburahimu akamanya ngu Besueri akaba ali mwana wa mugenzi wa Iburahimu arukwetwa Nahora. Omwiru akateeza amaju yasiima Yahwe habw’okumwebembera kumuhikya ha banyabuzaale ba Iburahimu.

Mu kiro ekyo, omwiru wa Iburahimu akagambira Besueri na munyanya wa Rebeka, Labani kiki ekyali kimulesiire. Boona bakaikiriza ngu Rebeka agende nawe aswerwe Isaka. Rebeka, obu bamukagwize akagamba ki? Akagarukamu ati: ‘Ego,’ akaba nagonza kugenda. Nahabwekyo ekiro ekyakurasireho, bakatemba engamira batandika orugendo rwabo okugaruka omu Kanani.

Bakahika Kanani mu rwebagyo. Rebeka akarora omusaija narubata omu musiri. Akaba ali Isaka. Akasemererwa muno kurora Rebeka. Nyina wa Isaka akaba amazire emyaka esatu afiire, akaba akyaali mubujune. Baitu Isaka akagonza muno Rebeka kandi yagarukamu kuba muntu w’omuhimbo nk’ogwakara.Okubanza 24:1-67. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

ABOOJO banu baali b’embaganiza, tinukwo? Nomanya amabara gabu? Omuhiigi akaba nuwe Esau, kandi ogu owakaba narolera entaama akaba nuwe Yakobo.

Esau na Yakobo baali barongo, baana ba Isaka na Rebeka. Isebo, Isaka akaaba nagonza muno Esau, habwokuba akaba ali muhiigi murungi ayaleteeraga ab’omuka ebyokulya. Baitu Rebeka yagonzaga Yakobo muno habwokuba akaba ali muculeezi kandi mwana murungi.



Isenkuru bo Iburahimu akaba akyaali mwomezi, kitekerezeho Yakobo nkoku yagonzaga muno kumuhuliriza n’okumugambira ebigambo bya Yahwe. Iburahimu akafa ahikiize emyaka 175 ey’obukuru, obu abarongo baali baine emyaka 15 ey’obukuru.

Esau obu yahikiize emyaka 40 ey’obukuru akaswera abakazi babiri ab’omunsi ya Kanani. Kinu kikabiihiza muno Isaka na Rebeka habwokuba abakazi banu baali tibarukuramya Yahwe.

Baitu kiro kimu, hakabaho ekintu ekyaletiire Esau kubihirirwa muno mugenzi we Yakobo. Obwire bukahika obwa Isaka okuha mutabani we omukuru omugisa. Nkoku akaba ali mukuru wa Yakobo, akaba nanihira kugutunga. Baitu Esau akaba agulize Yakobo obukuru bwe bw’okutunga omugisa nk’omwana omukuru. Baitu abaana banu ababiri obu bazairwe, Ruhanga akagamba ngu Yakobo nuwe yakutungire omugisa. Kandi kinu nikyo kyabaireho. Isaka akaha mutabani we Yakobo omugisa.

Obu Esau yamanyire ebyabaireho, nukwo kubihirirwa Yakobo. Akabihirwa muno n’okugamba ngu nagenda kwita Yakobo. Rebeka obu yabihuliire bikamweralikiriza muno. Rebeka akagambira iba, Isaka ati: ‘Nikijja kuba kibi muno kakuba Yakobo asweera abakazi abomu Kanani.’

Isaka akeeta Yakobo, mutabani we, yamugambira ati: ‘Otaliswera omukazi kuruga omu nsi ya Kanani. Hakiri ogende munju eyaswenkuru iwe, Besueri omu Harani. Oswere omu h’abahara ba Labani, mutabani we.’

Yakobo akahuliriza ise n’okugenderaho Harani omu banyabuzaale be.Okubanza 25:5-11, 20-34; 26:34, 35; 27:1-46; 28:1-5; Abaheburaniya 12:16, 17. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

NOMANYA abasaija banu Yakobo abarukubaza nabo? Hanyuma y’orugendo orw’ebiro bingi, Yakobo akasanga abasaija abo ha iziba. Baali nibeesera entaama zabo. Yakobo akabakaguza: ‘Nimuruga nkaha?’

Bamugarukamu, ‘Harani.’

Yakobo yagaruka kubakaguza ati; ‘Nimumanya Labani?’

Bagarukamu bati: ‘Ego. Dora na muhara we Rakeri naija nigana ly’entaama.’ Nosobora kurora Rakeri naija? Yakobo obu yarozire Rakeri hamu n’entaama za nyinarumi Labani, akagenda yaihaho ibale ha munwa gw’iziba nukwo entaama zisobole kunywa amaizi. Hanyuma Yakobo akanywegera Rakeri kandi yamweyanjurra. Rakeri akasemererwa muno, akairuka yagaruka omuka kugambira ise Labani.

Labani akasemererwa muno okwikara na Yakobo. Yakobo obu yasabire ngu aswere Rakeri, Labani akakisemerererwa. Baitu akasaba Yakobo okumulimira omu musiri gwe okumara emyaka musanju nukwo amuhe Rakeri nk’omukazi we. Habwokuba Yakobo akaba nagonza muno Rakeri kinu akakikora. Baitu akasumi obu kahikire Yakobo kutahya Rakeri, nomanya kiki ekyabaireho?

Labani akaha Yakobo omuhara we omukuru Leya mukikaro kya Rakeri. Yakobo akaikiriza kumukorra emyaka endi musanju, nubwo Labani yamuhaire Rakeri nk’omukazi we. Mu biro ebyo Ruhanga akaba naikiriza abasaija kuswera abakazi abarukukira hali omu. Baitu hati Baibuli eyoleka ngu omusaija aine kuba n’omukazi omu wenka.Okubanza 29:1-30. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA amaka ganu kamakooto. Banu boona bakaba batabani ba Yakobo 12. Baitu akaba aine n’abaisiki. Nomanya amabara gabu? Katubegeho.

Leya akazaara Reubeni, Simeoni, Levi na Yuda. Baitu obu Rakeri yaboine atarukusobora kuzaara, kikamubihiza muno. Hanyuma akaha Yakobo omuzana we Bira. Bira akazarra Yakobo abaana babiri, Dani na Nafutali. Na Leya nawe akaha Yakobo omuzana we Ziripa. Ziripa akazaara Gadi hamu na Aseri. Hanyuma Leya akagaruka yazaara aboojo abandi babiri, Isakara na Zeburani.

Hampero, Rakeri akazaara omwana yamuruka Yusufu. Nitwija kumwegaho bingi habwokuba akafooka muntu mukuru muno. Banu bali abaana ab’obwoojo 11 aba Yakobo, abayazaire obu akaba naikara na Labani ise wa Rakeri.

Yakobo akaba aine n’abaisiki, baitu Baibuli egambaho omu wenka. Ibara lye nuwe Dina.

Obwire bukahika Yakobo kuleka Labani agarukeyo Kanani. Akasoroza abantu be hamu n’amahyo ge ag’entaama nag’ente okutandika orugendo orw’amaani.

Hanyuma Yakobo nab’omuka ye bahikire Kanani, hakarabaho akaanya kake Rakeri yazaara omwana omwojo ondi. Orugendo Rakeri rukamubera ruzibu, kandi hanyuma akafa nazaara. Baitu omwana akaba ali mwomezi. Yakobo akamuruka Benyamini.

Nitugonza kwijuka amabara g’abatabani ba Yakobo 12 habwokuba ihanga lyoona erya Isareri nuho lyarugiire. Omu mananu, enganda 12 eza Isareri zikaruga omu batabani 10 aba Yakobo hamu n’abatabani babiri aba Yusufu. Isaka akomeera emyaka nyingi hanyuma y’okuzarwa kw’aboojo banu boona. Kuba n’abaijukuru baingi bati nikitekwa kuba kyamusemeize okutunga abaijukuru baingi batyo. Baitu katurole kiki ekyabaireho ha mwijukuru we omwisiki Dina.Okubanza 29:32-35; 30:1-26; 35:16-19; 37:35. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

NORORA abo Dina abarukugenda kubungira? Nagenda kurora abaisiki abaikaraga omunsi eya Kanani. Ekintu kinu Ise Yakobo yakukisimiire? Okutukonyera kugarukamu ekikaguzo kinu kurungi, lengaho oijuke nkoku Iburahimu na Isaka baroraga abakazi b’omu nsi ya Kanani. Iburahimu akagonza mutabani we Isaka kuswera omukazi kuruga omu Kanani? Nangwa, atakigonze. Kandi Isaka na Rebeka bakagonza Yakobo kuswera omukazi kuruga Kanani? Nangwa, batakigonze. N’omanya habwaki?

Habwokuba abantu abomu nsi ya Kanani baali nibaramya baruhanga ab’ebisuba. Bakaba batali barungi okuba nabo nk’abakazi rundi nk’abasaija omu maka. Kandi bakaba tibali barungi okuba nabo nk’enganjani. Hati norora ngu Yakobo tiyakusemerirwe okurora omuhara we kuba n’abaisiki b’Abakanani nk’abanywani be.

Mananu, Dina akagwa omu kabi. Norora omusaija Omukanani ow’omukisisani ekyo nkoku akurolerra muno Dina? Ibara lye nuwe Sekemu. Kiro kimu, Dina obuyaizire kubunga, Sekemu akatwara Dina n’okumuhambiriza kubyama nawe. Kinu kyali kibi muno habwokuba abantu abaswirengaine nibo bonka basemerire kubyama hamu. Ekintu eki Sekemu eki yakozire Dina kikarugwamu akabi kaingi.

Banyanya Dina obu bahuliire ekyabaireho, kikababihiza muno. Simoni na Levi bakabihirwa muno, bakakwata busitama zabu bagenda murubuga obu abantu baali batakubanihira. Bo n’abagenzi babo bakaita Sekemu hamu n’abasaija abandi boona. Yakobo akabihirwa muno habw’ekikorwa eki batabani be baakozire.

Akabi kanu koona kakatandika kata? Kakatandika habwokuba Dina akaganjana n’abantu abatarukworobera ebiragiro bya Ruhanga. Twakugondeze kuba n’abanywani nka banu, turaba nabo?Okubanza 34:1-31. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA omwojo onu nkoku aine obujune kandi atuntwire muno. Onu nuwe Yusufu. Bagenzi be baali bamazire ira kumuguza hali abasaija abo ababaka nibagenda Misiri. Yusufu naija kufoorwa omwiru rubale. Habwaki abaana baise banu bakozire ekintu kinu ekibi? Habwokuba bakamukwatirwa ihali.

Isebo, Yakobo akaba nagonza Yusufu muno. Kinu akakyoleka n’okumukorra ekanzu enungi muno. Bagenzi be 10 obu baroziire nkoku Yakobo arukugonza Yusufu, bakatandika kumukwatirwa ihali n’okumunoba. Baitu hakabaho n’ensonga endi habwaki bamunobire.

Yusufu akaroota ebirooto bibiri. Mu birooto binu ebya Yusufu hakaba harumu ekirikwoleka ngu bagenzi be baali nibamwinamira. Yusufu obu yaarotoriire bagenzi be, obwiko bwabwo bukeyongerra kimu.

Kiro kimu bagenzi ba Yusufu abakuru obu bakaba nibaliisa entaama za isebo, Yakobo akasaba Yusufu okugenda okurora nkoku bali. Bagenzi be obu bamulebere naija, abamu bakagamba bati: ‘Katumwite!’ Kyonka Reubeni mukuru wabu akagamba ngu: ‘Nangwa, mutakora ekyo!’ Kwihaho bakamukwata bamunaga omu kiina omukaba mutali maizi. Hanyuma bakaikarra hansi nukwo bacwemu ekibaramukora. Mukasumi ako, Abaisameri bakaba nibarabaho. Nukwo Yuda kugambira bagenzi be ati: ‘Katumuguze Abaisameri.’ Kandi kinu nikyo bakozire. Bakatunda Yusufu ebicweka by’efeeza 20. Eki bakozire kakikaba kintu ekitakwoleka mbabazi hamu n’ekisa!

Aboojo banu baakugambiire ki isebo? Bakaita embuzi, baibika ekanzu ya Yusufu omusagama yayo. Bagitwarra isebo Yakobo n’okumugamba: ‘Dora ekitusangire. Gyetegereze kurungi orole bweraba etaali niyo kanzu ya Yusufu.’

Yakobo obu yagyetegerize yasanga ngu niyo. ‘Enyamaiswa n’ezooka kuba emwisire,’ akarra muno. Kinu nikyo bagenzi ba Yusufu bagondeze isebo okwikiriza. Yakobo akatuntura muno. Akamara ebiro bingi nacura. Baitu Yusufu akaba atafiire. Katurole kiki ekyamuhikireho nambere bamutwaire.Okubanza 37:1-35. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

YUSUFU akaba ahikize emyaka 17 ey’obukuru obu bamutwaire omu Misiri. Bakamuguza omusaija owakaba namanywa nka Potifa. Potifa akaba nakora ow’omukama wa Misiri ow’akaba namanywa nka Faraho.

Yusufu akaba nakora n’amaani emirimu ya mukama we, Potifa. Obu yakuzire, Potifa akamuha obujunanizibwa bwoona obw’omu nju ye. Baitu, habwaki hati Yusufu atairwe omunkomo? Kinu kikarugirra ha mukazi wa Potifa.

Yusufu obu yakuzire akafooka musaija murungi muno, nahabwekyo mukazi wa Potifa akagonza Yusufu kubyama nawe. Yusufu akamanya ngu kinu kibi muno kandi akaba atarukusobora kukikora. Kinu kikabihiiza muno muka Potifa. Iba obu yagarukire omuka, mukaziwe akamubihirra ngu: ‘Yusufu musaija mubi muno, agondeze kubyama nanyowe!’ Potifa akaikiriza ebya mukazi we, kandi akabihirirwa muno Yusufu. Akaragira bamukwate bamuteeke munkomo.

Omusaija owakaba narolerra enkomo akarora Yusufu okuba musaija murungi. Nahabwekyo nukwo kumuha obujunanizibwa hali abanyankomo abandi. Hanyuma omwambukya n’omwokya bakabihiza Faraho. Boona bakabohwa omunkomo. Kiro, kimu buli omu akaroota ekirooto ekyembaganiza, kwonka bakaba tibarukusobora kukyetegereza. Ekiro ekyakurasireho, Yusufu yabasaba: ‘mungambire ebi murosiire.’ Obu bamazire, Yusufu nakonyerwa Ruhanga akabasoborra amakuru gaabyo.

Hali omwambukya, Yusufu akamugambira ati: ‘Mubiro bisatu noija kusumururwa kuruga omu munkomo, noija kugarukamu kukorra Faraho nkaira.’ Baitu Yusufu akamugambira ati: ‘Obwoliba orugire omunkomo ombazeho hali Faraho, onkonyere kuruga omukikaro kinu.’ Baitu oli omwokyi, Yusufu akamugambira ati: ‘Mubiro bisatu Faraho naija kukutemaho omutwe.’

Mubiro bisatu, ebintu binu byoona bikabaho nkoku Yusufu yagambire. Faraho akatemaho omutwe gw’omwokyi we. Omwambukya akamusumurra yagaruka kuhereza mukama we nkaira. Baitu omwambukya akeberwa kimu Yusufu! Nahabwekyo Yusufu akaikarra kimu omu nkomo.Okubanza 39:1-23; 40:1-23. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

YUSUFU akaikara omunkomo okumara emyaka endi ebiri. Omwambukya taramwijukiire kimu. Hanyuma, ekiro kimu Faraho akaroota ebirooto bibiri eby’omugaso muno, kandi akagonza muno okumanya amakuru gabyo. Nomurora nkoku abyamire? Obwire obu bwakiire, Faraho akeeta abasaija be boona abagezi yabarotorra eki akaba aroosire. Baitu batasobole kumusoborra amakuru g’ebirooto bye.

Mu kasumi kanu nubwo omwambukya yaijukire Yusufu. Yagambira Faraho: ‘Obu nkaba ndi munkomo, hakabayo omusaija eyasoboire kundotorra ebirooto byoona.’ Mubwangu Faraho akatuma baleete Yusufu kuruga munkomo. Faraho akagambira Yusufu ebirooto bye: ‘Nkarora ente musanju kandi zaali igomokere. Hanyuma narora ente musanju ezidodokere. Kandi ente embi zikalya ente enungi.’

‘Omu kirooto ekyakabiri, nkarora entwe musanju z’engano ezinyesere. Hanyuma narora entwe musanju ezindi enke. Kandi entwe zinu zatandika kumira entwe musanju ezinyesire ez’engano.’ Yusufu akagambira Faraho ati: ‘Ebirooto byombi nibimanyisa ekintu kimu. Ente musanju ezigomokere n’entwe musanju enungi nibimanyisa ngu halibaho emyaka musanju y’omweru omwingi omu Misiri, n’ente musanju ezanukiire hamu n’entwe musanju embi ez’engano nikimanyisa ngu halibaho n’emyaka endi musanju. Halibaho emyaka musanju ey’omweru omu Misiri. Hanyuma haligarukaho emyaka musanju endi ey’ibura ly’ebyokulya.’

Hampero, Yusufu yagambira Faraho: ‘Okome omusaija owa magezi omuteke mukusoroza ebyokulya mumyaka musanju ey’omweru. Kinu kikaba nikiija kukonyera abantu obutafa mubwire bw’enjara obw’emyaka musanju eyakukurasireho.’

Faraho akasiima ekitekerezo kinu. Nukwo yakoma Yusufu okusooroza ebyokulya n’okubihunika. Yusufu akafooka owakabiri hali Faraho.

Hanyuma y’emyaka munaana, mubwire bw’enjara, Yusufu akarora abasaija nibaija. Nomanya bakaba nibaha? Baali bagenzi be 10! Isebo Yakobo akaba abatumire omu Misiri habwokuba ebyokulya byaali bibakehereho omu Kanani. Yusufu akabetegereza, baitu bo batasobole kumumanyirra. Nomanya habwaki? Habwokuba Yusufu akaba akuzire kandi ajwaire ebijwaro eby’embaganiza.

Yusufu akaijuka ebi yaroosire obu akaba akyali musigazi ngu bagenzi be nibaija nibamwinamira. Nokijuka ngu okakisomaho? Yusufu akamanya ngu Ruhanga nuwe akaba amuherize omu Misiri ha bw’ensonga nungi. Hati kiki Yusufu eki yakozire? Katurole.Okubanza 41:1-57; 42:1-8; 50:20. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

YUSUFU akagonza kumanya bagenzi be 10 obu baraba bakyaine ihali n’obutaba n’ekisa. Akabagamba ati: ‘Muli ntasi. Mwizire okutata rundi ensi yaitu ngu teine mani.’

Bakagarukamu: ‘Nangwa tituli. Tuli basaija abesigwa. Itwena tuli baisemu. Tuli 12. Omugenzi waitu omu takyaroho, omuto muno asigaireyo omuka na’isitwe.’

Yusufu akesisaniza nkatarukubaikiriza. Akasigaza Semeoni ou yataire omunkomo, baitu yaleka abandi batwale ebyokulya n’okugarukayo. Akabagambira ngu: ‘Obu muligaruka, mwije na mugenzi wanyu omuto.’

Obu batahire omuka, Kanani, bagambira Yakobo byoona ebyababaireho. Yakobo akatuntura muno. Akatandika n’okucura muno ati, ‘Yusufu takyaroho nahati na Simeoni. Tindukwija kubaikiriza kutwara omwana wange omuto Benyamini.’ Ebyokulya obu byatandikire okubakehaho, Yakobo akaleka batwara Benyamini omu Misiri nukwo batunge ebyokulya.

Yusufu akaleeba bagenzi be nibaija. Yasemererwa muno okurora mugenzi we omuto Benyamini. Busaho nomu akaba namanyira kimu ngu omukuru onu nuwe Yusufu. Yusufu akakora ekintu ekyokulengesa bagenzi be banu 10.

Akaragira abahereza be kwijuza ensahu zaabu n’ebyokulya. Kandi bateeke ekikopo eky’efeeza ekya Yusufu omu nsahu eya Benyamini batabagambiire. Obu bamazire kugendaho kumara omwanya, Yusufu akatuma abairu be okubahondera. Obu babahikireho, abairu bakabakaguza: ‘Habwaki mwibire ekikopo kya mukama waitu eky’efeeza?’

Boona bakagarukamu bati: ‘Itwe titwibire kikopo. Ogu oworasanga n’ekikopo aitwe.’

Nukwo abairu bakaserra munsahu zoona baitu bakakisanga omunsahu eya Benyamini nkoku orukurora hanu. Abairu bakabagambira ngu: ‘Abandi nimusobora kweyongera n’orugendo rwanyu, baitu Benyamini aine kugarukayo n’aitwe.’ Kiki bagenzi be 10 eki bakozire?

Boona bakagarukayo na Benyamini munju ya Yusufu. Nukwo Yusufu kugambira bagenzi be ati: ‘Abandi nimusobora kutaaha, baitu Benyamini aine kusigara hanu nk’omwiru wange.’

Yuda nukwo kugamba ati: ‘Kakuba ngarukayo omuka ntaine omwana ogu, Isitwe naija kufa habwokuba amugonza muno. Hati nkwesengerize, leka nyowe ngume hanu nk’omwiru wawe, baitu oleke omwojo agarukeyo omuka.’

Yusufu akarora ngu bagenzi be baali bahindwireho muno ha ngeso zabu. Bakaba tibakyali b’itima n’obutagira kisa. Hati leka turole kiki Yusufu ekiyakozire.Okubanza 42:9-38; 43:1-34; 44:1-34. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

YUSUFU akaba atakyasobora kusereka enyehurra ye ey’omunda. Akagambira abahereza be boona kurugaho. Obu yasigaire wenka n’abagenzi be, Yusufu akatandika okurra. Cumitiriza kinu okukitekwa kuba kyahunirize bagenzi be, habwokuba bali batarukumanya habwaki akaba narra. Hamperu, akabagambira ati: ‘Ninyowe Yusufu. Isenyowe akiri mwomezi?’

Bagenzi be boona baali bakyahunirire muno n’ekyokubaza kikababura. Bakatiina muno. Baitu Yusufu akabagambira ati: ‘Mwirre haihi.’ Obu bakikozire yabagambira ngu: ‘Ninyowe mugenzi wanyu Yusufu ou mwatunzire omu Misiri.’

Yusufu akeyongera kubaza nabo n’ekisa: ‘Mutetaho omusango ngu mukanguza hanu. Kyonka Ruhanga nuwe yantumire omu Misiri okukiza obwomezi bw’abantu. Faraho akanfoora omukuru omu Misiri yoona. Hati murahuke mugende hali Isenyowe kandi mumugambire aije aikale hanu.’

Hanyuma Yusufu yagwa bagenzi be mukifuba n’okubanywegera boona. Obu Faraho yahuliire ngu bagenzi ba Yusufu baizire, yaragira Yusufu ati: ‘Batwale amagali baleete ise hamu n’amaka ge baije baikale hanu. Ninyija okubaha ekicweka eky’orwezo omu Misiri.’

Kino nikyo bakozire. Hanu norora Yusufu nataangirra ise obu yahikire omu Misiri hamu n’amaka ge. Abantu ab’omu nju ya Yakobo baali beyongerire kimu okuba abaingi. Hati bakaba bali 70 abafurukiire Misiri, otwaliiremu Yakobo n’abatabani hamu na baijukuru be. Baitu hakaba harumu n’abakazi babu n’abahereza babu. Boona bakatandika kwikarra kimu omu Misiri. Bakamanywa nk’Abaisareri habwokuba Ruhanga akahindura Ibara lya Yakobo okuba Isareri. Abaisareri bakafoka bantu bembaganiza muno nkoku turarora.Okubanza 45:1-28; 46:1-27. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

NOHURRA nosalirwa habwa omusaija omurwaire ogu? Ibara lye nuwe Yobu, n’omukazi ogu nuwe nyinabwenge we. Nomanya ekyarukugambira Yobu? ‘Kyena Ruhanga ofe.’ Katurole habwaki yagambiire ati Yobu kandi habwaki Yobu yaboineboine ati muno.

Yobu akaba ali musaija mwesigwa kandi akaba nayorobera muno Yahwe. Yaikaraga omunsi ya Uzi ekikaba kitali hara na Kanani. Yahwe yagonzaga muno Yobu, baitu hakaba haroho omuntu ondi akaba atarukumugonza. Nomumanya?

Onu nuwe Setani Diabolo. Ijuka, Sitani nuwe maraika omubi arukunobera kimu Yahwe. Nuwe yareterize Adamu na Hawa obutorobera Yahwe kandi akaba natekereza ngu nasobora kujemesa abantu boona kubaiha hali Yahwe. Kinu akakisobora? Nangwa. Ijuka abasaija n’abakazi abesigwa abatwayegereho. Nibaingaha ab’orukwijuka amabara gabu?

Hanyuma y’okufa kwa Yakobo na Yusufu omu Misiri, Yobu nuwe akaba nakirayo kuba mwesigwa omu nsi yoona. Yahwe akagonza kukyoleka Setani ngu tarukusobora kufoora abantu boona kuba babi, hanyuma akamugambira: ‘Dora Yobu. Norora nkoku arukunyesiga?’

Setani akahakana: ‘Ni mwesigwa habwokuba omuhaire omugisa kandi aine ebintu ebirungi bingi. Kakuba obimwihaho, naija kukwehakana.’

Hanyuma Yahwe akamugambira ati: ‘Genda omumaiso obimwiheho. Omukole kyona ekibi ekyoragonza. Turore obu aranyehakana. Baitu otamwita.’ Okubanza, Sitani akaleta abasaija baiba ente zoona n’engamira eza Yobu, kandi entaama ze zoona baziita. Hanyuma yaita abaana ba Yobu 10 aboojo n’abaisiki omu ihunga lyamani. Hanyuma ya byoona Sitani akarwaza Yobu oburwaire bw’amaani muno. Yobu akabonabona muno. Nahabwekyo nuho mukazi wa Yobu yarugirire kugamba iba ati: ‘Wehakane Ruhanga ofe.’ Baitu Yobu akaba atarukusobora kukora ekintu nkeki. N’abanywani be ab’obugobya bakaija bamugambira ngu akaba ali w’engeso mbi muno mubwomezi bwe. Baitu Yobu akasigara mwesigwa.

Kinu kikasemeza muno Yahwe, hanyuma akaha Yobu omugisa nkoku orukurora omukisisani. Akamukiza oburwaire bwoona. Yobu akatunga abaana bandi 10 abaali barungi muno. Ruhanga akamuha ente, entaama, engamira enungi emirundi ebiri.

Naiwe oraikaraga oli mwesigwa hali Yahwe nkoku Yobu yakozire? Kakuba okikora, Ruhanga naija kukuha emigisa. Olisobora kwomera ebiro n’ebiro omu nsi obwerifooka nk’orugonjo rwa Adeni.Yobu 1:1-22; 2:1-13; 42:10-17. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

ABASAIJA abo nibahambiriza abantu kukora. Dora omusaija nateera omu h’abakozi n’omwigo! Abakozi boona baali nibaruga omu maka ga Yakobo, kandi baali nibamanywa nk’Abaisareri. Abasaija abakaba nibabahambiriza kukora bakaba bali Bamisiri. Abaisareri hati bakaba bafokere bairu b’Abamisiri. Kinu kikabaho kita?

Amaka ga Yakobo agaali makoto muno, bakamara omu Misiri obusumi bwingi muno omu businge. Yusufu ayabaire musaija w’ekitiinisa muno kandi ow’akabiri hali Faraho, yabarolerraga. Baitu Yusufu obu yafiire, Faraho ondi owakaba atarukugondeza kimu Abaisareri akatandika kulema Misiri.

Hanyuma, Faraho onu akafoora Abaisareri okuba abairu rubale. Kandi akataho abasaija ababi n’abitima okubarolerra mukukora. Banu bakaba nibahambiriza muno Abaisareri okwombeka embuga za Faraho. Kyonka Abaisareri bakeyongera kukanya muno. Kinu kikatiinisa muno Abamisiri, bakatekereza ngu nibaija kuba baingi muno nokuba b’amaani muno. Nomanya eki Faraho yakozire? Akagambira abasehenyi b’Abaisareri ati: ‘Omwana w’obwojo arazaarwa weena mumwite.’ Baitu banu bakaba baali bakazi barungi muno, batabaite.

Hanyuma Faraho akaha ekiragiro hali abantu be boona: ‘Mwite abaana boona ab’obwojo ab’Abaisareri. Abaana ab’obwisiki bonka nubo muleke bomezi.’ Kinu kikaba kitali kibi muno? Katurole omwana omu ow’obwojo nkoku yakizibwemu.Okuruga 1:6-22. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

data.titulo: Omulingo Musa Ogu Yakiziibwemu Akyali Nkerembe
data.contenido:
DORA omwana omuto narra, kandi akwasire harunkumu rw’omukazi. Onu nuwe Musa. Nomanya omukazi ogu omurungi muno noha? Omu h’ababitokati ba Misiri, muhara wa Faraho.

Nyina wa Musa akamusereka okuhikya obu yahikiize emyezi esatu ey’obukuru habwokuba atagonze Abamisiri kumwita. Akamanya ngu nibaija kumuzoora nahabwekyo kinu nikyo yakozere kumukiza.

Akakora ekibaya ky’orufunjo, yakisiiga kurungi muno nukwo amaizi gatarabamu. Akamutamu, hanyuma yateeka ekibaya omu mateehe ha musa gw’Ekyambu ekya Nailo. Munyanya Musa Miryamu, akaba agambiirwe kwemerra haihi nukwo arole kiki ekirabaho. Muhara wa Farawo akaija ha Kyambu kya Nailo kwooga. Yarora ekibaya mu mateehe. Nukwo yayesire omu h’abazana be: ‘Genda ondetere ekibaya kiri.’ Omubitokati obu yakisumurwire akarora omwana omurungi muno. Aho nuho Musa yatandikire kurra nukwo omubitokati yamukwatirwe ekisa. Atagonze abantu kumwita.

Miryamu akasembera haihi nkoku orukurora omu kisisani. Miryamu akakaguza muhara wa Faraho: ‘Ngende nkwetere omu h’abakazi b’Abaisareri aije akukonyere kukwonkeza omwana ogu?’

Omubitokati akamugarukamu ati: ‘Ego.’

Miryamu akairuka yagambira nyina. Obu nyina yaizire, omubitokati akamugambira ati: ‘Twara omwana onu omundolererre, nanyowe ndikuha empera.’

Nahabwekyo nyina wa Musa akatwara omwana ou yaayezaaliire. Musa obu yakuzire, nukwo kumutwarra muhara wa Faraho ayamukulize nk’omutabani we. Kunu nukwo Musa yaizire kukurra omu maka ga Faraho.Okuruga 2:1-10. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA Musa nairuka kuruga omu Misiri. Norora n’abasaija abarukumuhambya? Nomanya habwaki nibenda kumwita? Katurole obuturaba turakizora.

Musa akakurra mu maka ga Faraho, omulemi wa Misiri. Musa akafooka musaija w’amagezi kandi w’omugaso muno. Musa akamanya kurungi ngu akaba atali Mumisiri, n’abazaire be benyini bakaba Baisareri.

Kiro kimu, obwakaba ahikize emyaka 40 ey’obukuru, akagenda kuramburaho abantu be nkoku bakaba bali. Kikaba nikisaliza muno kurora nkoku bakaba nibatwarwa kubi muno. Akarora Omumisiri nateera muno omwiru Omuisareri. Musa akamagamaga, obu yaboine hataroho muntu ondi weena arukumurora, akateera Omumisiri, yamwita. Hanyuma Musa akasereka omurambo gwe omu musenyu.

Ekiro ekyakurasireho, akagarukayo kurambura abantu be. Akatekereza ngu naija kubakonyera kulekeraho kuba abairu rubale. Kyonka akarora Abaisareri babiri nibarwana nukwo Musa kukaguza ogu akaba ali mu nsobi ati: ‘Habwaki n’orwana na mugenzi wawe?’

Nukwo omusaija kumugarukamu ati: ‘Noha yakufoire kuba mukuru n’okuba mucwi w’emisango? Noyenda kunyita nkoku oisire Omumisiri?’

Musa akatiina muno. Akakimanya kurungi nti abantu boona bakaba bamanyire eki akozire Omumisiri. Na Faraho akakimanya, nukwo kutuma abasaija abo kwija kwita Musa. Enu niyo nsonga habwaki Musa akaba aine kwiruka kuruga omu Misiri.

Musa obu yairukire kuruga omu Misiri, akagenda hara muno omu nsi y’Abamidiani. Oku niho yatangatanganire amaka ga Yesero n’okuswera omu h’abahara be ayayetwaga Zipora. Musa akafooka muliisa w’entaama za Yesero. Akamara emyaka 40 mu nsi ya Midiani. Hati akaba ahikize emyaka 80 ey’obukuru. Baitu kiro kimu Musa bwakaba naliisa entaama za Yesero, ekintu kyokuhuniriza kikabaho ekyahindwireho obwomezi bwe bwoona. Sukura orupapura nukwo turole ekintu ekyokuhuniriza ekyabaireho.Okuruga 2:11-25; Engeso 7:22-29. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

MUSA akaba agendiire kimu ha rusozi orwa Holebu okuserurra entaama ze obunyansi. Hanu akarora ekisaka kiroho omurro, baitu kikaba kitarukusiriira!

‘Ekintu kinu kanikihuniriza muno,’ nukwo Musa yatekerize. ‘Ati kanyirre haihi nukwo nyetegereze kurungi.’ Obu yakikozire, iraka likaruga omu kisaka nirigamba ngu: ‘Otairra haihi. Oihemu enkaito mubigere byawe habwokuba nambere oyemeriire harukwera.’ Ruhanga nuwe akaba nagamba naraba omu maraika, nahabwekyo Musa yayesweka h’amaiso.

Ruhanga akagamba: ‘Baitu ndozire emihito y’abantu bange omu Misiri. Ningenda kubajuna kandi niwe ndukugenda kutuma kwebembera abantu bange kubaiha Misiri.’ Yahwe akaba nagenda kwiha abantu be kuruga Misiri n’okubaleeta mu nsi enungi eya Kanani.

Baitu Musa akagamba: ‘Ninyowe oha. Nsobora nta kukora ekintu kinu? Kakuba ngenda h’Abaisareri. Nibaija kunkaguza bati: “Noha akutumire? Ndibagarukamu nta?”

‘Kinu nikyo olibagambira,’ Ruhanga yagarukamu. ‘YAHWE, Ruhanga wa Iburahimu, Ruhanga owa Isaka, Ruhanga owa Yakobo nuwe antumire hali inywe.’ Kandi Ruhanga akongeraho ati: ‘Eri niryo ibara lyange ebiro byona.’

Musa yagarukamu ati: ‘Baitu kakuba batanyikirize obu ndabagambira ngu niwe ontumire.’

Ruhanga yamukaguza ati: ‘Kiki ekiri omu mukono gwawe?’

Musa yagarukamu ati: ‘Mwigo.’

Ruhanga yamugambira ati: ‘Gunage hansi.’ Obu Musa yakikozire, omwigo gwafooka enjoka. Yahwe akoleka Musa ekyamahano ekindi. Akamugamba: ‘Ta omukono gwawe omunda y’ekijwaro kyawe.’ Musa obu yakikozire, kandi obu yagwihireyo gwona gwaali nigwera nk’ebirika! Omukono gukazooka gwine oburwaire obubi muno oburukumanywa nk’ebigenge. Yahwe akaha Musa amaani kukora ekyamahano ekyakasatu. Hamperu akamugambira ngu: ‘Obu orakora ebyamahano binu byoona, Abaisareri nibaija kwikiriza ngu nkutumire.’

Hanyuma ya binu, Musa akagenda omuka yagambira Yesero: ‘Nkwesengerize leka ngende hali abanyabuzaale bange ab’omu Misiri ndole nkoku bali.’ Nahabwekyo Yesero akaraga Musa, na Musa akatandikiraho orugendo rwe okugaruka Misiri.Okuruga 3:1-22; 4:1-20. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

data.titulo: Musa na Aroni Bagenda owa Faraho
data.contenido:
MUSA obu yagarukire Misiri, yagambira mugenzi we Aroni hali eby’amahano byona. Kandi Musa na Aroni obu bagambire Abaisareri ha by’amahano binu, abantu bakaikiriza ngu Yahwe akaba ali nabo.

Hanyuma Musa na Aroni bakagenda kurora Faraho. Bakamugambira bati: ‘Yahwe Ruhanga ow’Abaisareri agambire ati: Leka abantu bange bagende bandamye okumara ebiro bisatu omu Irungu.’ Baitu Faraho akagamba ati: ‘Tindukwikiririza omu Yahwe. Kandi tindukwija kuleka Abaisareri kugenda.’

Faraho akabihirwa habwokuba, abantu baali nibagonza kutungaho obwire kuruga ha mirimo nukwo baramye Yahwe. Nukwo yatandikire kubahambiririza kimu kukora muno. Abaisareri bakejuma Musa habw’omulingo bayongiirwe kubonabonesebwa, na Musa akahurra kubi. Baitu Yahwe akamugamba ngu aleke kweralikirra. ‘Ninyija kuhambiriza Faraho okuleka abantu bange bagende,’ nukwo Yahwe yagambire. Musa na Aroni bakagenda kurora Faraho omurundi gundi. Omurundi gunu bakakora ekyamahano. Aroni akanaga omwigo gwe hansi, gwafooka enjoka enkooto. Baitu abagezigezi ba Faraho nabo bakanaga emigo yabo hansi nayo yaafoka njoka. Baitu dora kinu! Enjoka ya Aroni n’emira enjoka z’abagezigezi. Baitu Faraho atasobole kulekera Abaisareri.

Akasumi kakahika Yahwe kufubira Faraho. Nomanya eki yakozire? Kyali kuleta emihito 10 rundi ebibonerezo hali Misiri.

Hanyuma y’emihito emu, Faraho akeeta Musa yamugambira: ‘Yemereza emihito, nanyowe ndaikiriza Isareri kugenda.’ Baitu obu omuhito gwahwahoga, Faraho akaba nayehindura. Akaba atarukubalekera kugenda. Hanyuma y’omuhito ogwa ikumi, nubwo Faraho yalekiire Abaisareri.

Buli gumu ha mihito nogumanya? Sukura ha rupapura orurukukurataho, nukwo tugyegeho.Okuruga 4:27-31; 5:1-23; 6:1-13, 26-30; 7:1-13. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

ROLERRA ebisisani binu. Buli kimu nikyoleka omuhito Yahwe ogu yaletiire ensi ya Misiri. Omukisisani eky’okubanza nosobora kurora Aroni natera omwigo gwe hali amaizi ag’omu Kyambu kya Nailo. Obu yakikozire, amaizi goona gakafooka sagama. Encu zoona zikafa, n’ekyambu kyoona kyatandika kununka. Ekyahondiireho, Yahwe akaleta ebikere kuruga omu kyambu kya Nailo. Bikagenda hoona, omunju, omukitabu, omubyoto, omukisiika na buli hantu. Ebikere obu byafiire, Abamisiri bakabisoroza entumo n’entumo n’ensi yoona ekanunka muno.

Aroni obu yagoroire omwigo gwe yatera ecucu y’ensi, ekafooka obuhuka oburukusisana enkukuni. Bunu buhuka obutaito muno oburukuguruka kyonka niburuma muno. Bunu buhuka oburukusisana enkukuni nibwo bwali omuhito gwa kasatu hali ensi eya Misiri. Emihito eyagarukireho ekarumya Abamisiri bonka hatali Abaisareri. Omuhito ogwakana gukaba emizinga y’ensohera eyaijwire omu maju goona ag’Abamisiri. Omuhito ogwa kataano gwali hali ebisoro. Ente, entaama hamu n’embuzi ezirukukira obwingi ez’Abamisiri zikafa.

Hanyuma y’ebintu binu, Musa na Aroni bakatwara iju balimisa omumwanya. Likaleta ebizimba n’ebihoya hali abantu n’ebisoro. Gunu nugwo omuhito ogwa mukaaga.

Hanyuma yeki, Musa akaimukya emikono ye haiguru, nubwo Yahwe akaleeta enkuba hamu n’orubale. Runu rukaba rubale orubi muno orutakabahoga omu Misiri. Omuhito ogwa munana gukaba enzige enyingi muno. Hakaba hatakabahoga enzige nyingi ziti. Zikalya buli kintu eki orubale rutarasisire.

Omuhito ogwa mwenda gukaba mwirima. Okumara ebiro bisatu ensi yoona eya Misiri ekaba omu mwirima kwihaho ekiikaro nambere Abaisareri bakaba nibaikara.

Hakumalirra, Ruhanga akagambira abantu be okusiiga esagama ye kyana ky’embuzi rundi entaama ha mikumirro y’enyigi zabu. Maraika wa Ruhanga akaraba omu Misiri. Obu yakuboine esagama, tiyakwisire muntu wena anyakuli omunju egyo. Baitu enju yoona etarabaireho sagama ha mukumirro gw’orwigi rwayo, maraika wa Mukama akaita buli muzigaijo gw’abantu hamu n’ebisoro. Gunu nigwo muhito ogwa 10.

Hanyuma y’omuhito gunu ogwa hampero, Faraho akagambira Abaisareri ngu bagende. Abantu ba Ruhanga bakaba betekanize kugenda, mukiro ekyo bakatandikiraho orugendo rwabu okuruga mu Misiri.Okuruga suura 7 kuhika 12. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega

DORA hati ekiri hanu! Ogu nuwe Musa n’omwigo gwe agugoroire h’amaizi ag’Enyanja Erukutukura. Abo abali nawe ha rubaju nibo Baisareri. Baitu Faraho n’amahe ge goona bakafeera omunyanja. Katurole nkoku kyabaireho.

Nkoku twayegere, Faraho akagambira Abaisareri kuruga omu Misiri hanyuma ya Ruhanga okuleta emihito 10 hali Abamisiri. Abasaija b’Abaisareri nka 600,000 nubo barugireyo hamu n’abakazi, n’abaana. Otaireho n’ekitebe ekikooto ky’abantu abandi abakaba bafookere Abaikiriza omuli Yahwe, nabo bakarugayo hamu n’Abaisareri. Bakarugayo n’entaama, n’ente hamu n’embuzi zabu.

Obu bakaba batakarugire omu Misiri, Abaisareri bakasaba aba Misiri okubaha ebijwaro n’ebintu ebya zabbu hamu n’efeeza. Abamisiri bakaba batiinire muno habw’omuhito ogwa hampero ogwali gubaireho. Nahabwekyo bakahayo kyoona eki Abaisareri baali nibasaba.

Hanyuma y’ebiro bike, Abaisareri bakahika ha Nyanja Erukutukura. Aho nuho bahumuliire. Omu bwire obu, Faraho n’abasaija be bakaba nibeijukya habwaki baikirize Abaisareri okubarugaho. ‘Tulekere abairu baitu okugenda!’ nukwo bagambire.

Faraho akahinduraho ekitekerezo kye. Akatekaniza amagali ge ag’obulemu hamu n’abamahe ge. Yatandika kuhambya Abaisareri n’amagali 600 agaali marungi muno hamu n’amagali agandi agaali omu Misiri.

Abaisareri obu baboine Faraho n’amahe ge, nibabasemberra, batiina muno. Baitu hali hataroho h’okwirukira. Enyanja Erukutukura orubaju orumu n’Abamisiri abakaba orubaju orundi. Baitu Yahwe akateka ekicu hagati y’abantu be n’Abamisiri. Nahabwekyo kinu kikagumira muno Abamisiri okurora Abaisareri n’okubarumba.

Yahwe akaragira Musa okwimukya omwigo gwe hali Enyanja Erukutukura. Obu yakikozire, Yahwe akaleeta ihunga ly’amaani. Likateera amaizi ag’enyanja, nukwo kwebaganizamu, n’okusigara gemerire ha mbaju zombi.

Abaisareri bakatandika kuraba omunyanja haitaka eryomere. Kikatwara omwanya obukaikuru n’obukaikuru bw’abantu boona kucwanganiza enyanja hamu n’ebisoro byabo. Obu Abamisiri bagarukire kurora Abaisareri, abairu baabu baali babagenzireho ira! Nukwo kwirukira mu nyanja banguhe basobole kubakwata.

Obu bakozire kinu, Ruhanga akaihaho enyamuziga za magali gabu. Nahabwekyo Abamisiri bakatandika kutiina muno n’okukunga ngu: ‘Yahwe narwanirra Abaisareri. Katwiruke tugaruke enyuma!’ Baitu kikaba kitakyasoboka nakake.

Omu kasumi kanu nuho Yahwe yagambiire Musa kugorra omwigo gwe hali Enyanja Erukutukura nkoku murukurora omukisisani. Musa obu yakikozire ati, ebisiika by’amaizi bikagaruka, byaterana byahwerekereza Abamisiri boona, n’amagali gabu. Busawo n’omu h’Abamisiri ayakizireho! Abantu ba Ruhanga kabakaba n’omuhimbo gwa mani muno habw’okukizibwaho! Abasaija bakazina ekizina eky’okusiima Yahwe bati: ‘Yahwe asingire obulemu obw’ekitinisa. Anagire embarasi hamu nabazibaireho omunyanja.’ Munyanya Musa, Miryamu akakwata ijugo lye hamu n’abakazi boona bamukurata hamu n’amajugo gabu. Nibazina n’omuhimbo, nibazinira hamu ekizina eky’abasaija eki baali nibazina: ‘Yahwe asingire obulemu bw’ekitinisa. Anagire embarasi hamu nabo abazibaireho omu nyanja.’Okuruga suura 12 kuhika 15. Ebikaguzo eby’Okukozesa mu Kwega
